about.title: About MATTE
about.intro: Quality bathroom, plumbing and water equipment for homes, businesses and projects across Rwanda.
about.storyBody: MATTE helps customers choose dependable products for bathrooms, plumbing and water systems. Our Kigali team brings practical product knowledge and local support to every project.
about.missionBody: Make it easier to build and improve comfortable, reliable spaces with considered products and clear service.
about.valuesBody: We listen to the needs of each project, explain product options clearly, and support customers from selection through delivery or collection.
